categories.supplyChainImpact: P&I war-risk constraints continue to divert or delay Gulf shipping as the direct tanker war persists and Iran-Gulf talks remain shelved. Reuters reported Sep 16 that Saudi Aramco is rerouting crude through Hormuz via Sohar ship-to-ship transfers after a Sep 11 drone strike shut its East-West pipeline, and Sep 17 that Hormuz tanker crossings remain in single digits amid a record VLCC ordering wave (217 in 2026 vs 93 in 2025). Reuters' Sep 11 report carries a route-specific Gulf of Oman-to-China VLCC assessment near Worldscale 450, roughly $11.50/bbl; the displayed AG-Asia WS105 estimate and current LNG freight remain outside the commercial evaluation because no matching route-normalised close is approved.
